articles.title: Critical F5 BIG-IP Stack Buffer Overflow Flaw Enables Remote Code Execution and Denial-of-Service Attacks
articles.summary:
F5 disclosed a critical stack-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) on November 18, 2026. Tracked as CVE-2026-123637, the flaw allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to terminate the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM), interrupting traffic while the process restarts. articles.title: China-Linked Webworm Hackers Deploy Custom SoftEther VPN to Maintain Hidden Access to Government Networks
articles.summary:
